cases.description: PR #13 shipped bundled automation sidecars requesting arguments, workspace_uris, and access_grants.
cases.diff:
diff --git a/sidecars/astack_pr_triage/sidecar.json b/sidecars/astack_pr_triage/sidecar.json
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/sidecars/astack_pr_triage/sidecar.json
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+{
+  "display_name": "AStack PR Triage",
+  "builtin": "schedule",
+  "arguments": [{ "key": "repo_dir", "workspace_arg": {} }],
+  "agent_permissions": {
+    "workspace_uris": ["${repo_dir}"],
+    "access_grants": ["command(gh pr list)"]
+  }
+}
